name: Water Heater
summary: Heats and stores domestic hot water.
education: Tank-style water heaters typically last 8-12 years. Sediment builds up at the bottom over time, reducing efficiency and capacity. A failing pressure-relief valve or anode rod is far cheaper to replace than the tank itself.

suggested_photos.prompt: Full unit including connections at the top
The drain valve at the base

maintenance.action: Flush the tank to clear sediment
maintenance.why: Sediment insulates the burner from the water, raising bills and shortening the tank's life.
A stuck valve cannot vent excess pressure, which is a real safety hazard.
The anode corrodes in place of the tank. When it's gone, the tank starts to.
